julius-caesar: Later depiction: Renaissance sculpture by Andrea Ferrucci, circa 1512–14.
gordian-i: Ancient portrait head on a modern bust; identification as Gordian I is uncertain.
cniva: Modern imagined battle scene (2025). Cniva is the standing figure behind Decius.
claudius-gothicus: Ancient bronze head; identification as Claudius II is disputed. It has also been attributed to Aurelian.
maximinus-daza: Ancient sculptural portrait; identification as Maximinus II is uncertain.
julian-emperor: Ancient chalcedony portrait; identification as Julian is uncertain.
